verdict.rationale: Community hands-on reports confirm Ollama ships its own desktop chat app for macOS and Windows, with multimodal and Markdown rendering working as expected. However, no first-party docs in the pack describe the GUI, it is unavailable on Linux, and users note it cannot connect to a remote Ollama instance. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the chat GUI, Linux support, remote-instance connection, and power-user controls in the interface.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can chat with local models using a built-in graphical chat interface

citations.quote: Ollama's new app is now available for macOS and Windows
Multimodal and Markdown support works as expected.
